title: Production Durable Knowledge Graph Persistence Integration
objective: Integrate the existing production Assimilation-to-Knowledge execution boundary with the authoritative durable KnowledgeGraph persistence boundary so a successfully built validated Knowledge graph can be durably persisted under an explicit caller-supplied persistence key without granting storage authority to the deterministic Knowledge Engine, duplicating validation authority, or broadening orchestration authority.

architecturalDecision.compositionBoundary: AssimilationKnowledgeExecution remains the production composition boundary for authoritative Assimilation retrieval and deterministic Knowledge execution. KNOWLEDGE-003 adds explicit persistence composition there rather than inside DeterministicKnowledgeEngine or the orchestration layer.
architecturalDecision.durablePayload: Persist KnowledgeEngineResult.graph directly as the existing canonical KnowledgeGraph aggregate. Do not introduce a second graph model, record model, serialization model, or graph identifier.
architecturalDecision.persistenceIdentity: The caller supplies the explicit Knowledge graph persistence key established by KNOWLEDGE-002. AssetId is not silently redefined as a canonical KnowledgeGraph identifier.
architecturalDecision.validationAuthority: KnowledgeGraphPersistence remains authoritative for persistence-time graph validation and containment. AssimilationKnowledgeExecution delegates persistence and does not duplicate validateKnowledgeGraph semantic rules.
architecturalDecision.failureOrdering: Authoritative Assimilation retrieval must succeed before Knowledge execution; Knowledge execution must succeed before persistence; persistence failure propagates to the caller. No later stage runs after an earlier-stage failure.

allowedBehavior: Extend AssimilationKnowledgeExecutionService with one explicit asynchronous production execution-and-persistence operation accepting AssetId, caller-supplied Knowledge graph persistence key, authoritative production Assimilation retrieval dependency, and KnowledgeGraphPersistence dependency.
Delegate authoritative generated-record retrieval through ProductionSourceAssimilationService.retrieveGeneratedRecords exactly as the existing production handoff does.
Reuse the existing execute path for Assimilation-to-Knowledge mapping and deterministic KnowledgeEngine execution rather than creating a second mapper or Knowledge execution path.
After successful Knowledge execution, delegate result.graph directly to KnowledgeGraphPersistence.persist using the exact caller-supplied persistence key.
Return the existing KnowledgeEngineResult unchanged after successful persistence.
Propagate authoritative Assimilation retrieval failure without executing Knowledge or persistence.
Propagate Knowledge execution failure without invoking persistence.
Propagate KnowledgeGraphPersistence.persist failure rather than reporting successful production completion.
Preserve existing execute and executeFromProductionRecords behavior unchanged.
Keep production composition local and explicit with no orchestration, network, database, model, credential, deployment, publication, or autonomous execution authority.
nonGoals: Changes to DeterministicKnowledgeEngine or automatic persistence inside the Knowledge Engine.
Changes to KnowledgeGraph, KnowledgeEngineResult, Knowledge node, relation, claim, revision, or provenance contracts.
Changes to KNOWLEDGE-002 filesystem persistence implementation, path rules, serialization, retrieval, or validation behavior.
Query, reasoning, insight, revision semantics, or Knowledge intelligence changes.
Changes to ProductionSourceAssimilationService or Assimilation persistence.
Changes to src/lib/orchestration or workflow handlers.
Choosing AssetId as a canonical KnowledgeGraph identifier.
Remote storage, databases, network access, model invocation, credential access, deployment, commit, push, or publication authority.
acceptanceCriteria: A caller can execute the authoritative production Assimilation-to-Knowledge path and persist the resulting KnowledgeEngineResult.graph through an injected KnowledgeGraphPersistence dependency under an explicit caller-supplied persistence key.
The exact KnowledgeEngineResult returned by the existing Knowledge execution path is returned unchanged after successful persistence.
Persistence receives exactly the caller-supplied key and exactly the graph contained in the successful KnowledgeEngineResult.
Authoritative production Assimilation retrieval is invoked exactly once for the requested AssetId.
Existing Assimilation-to-Knowledge mapping and KnowledgeEngine execution are reused rather than duplicated.
Assimilation retrieval failure propagates and causes zero Knowledge execution and zero Knowledge persistence.
Knowledge execution failure propagates and causes zero Knowledge persistence.
Persistence failure propagates after successful retrieval and Knowledge execution.
Existing execute and executeFromProductionRecords behavior remain unchanged.
No persistence validation semantics are duplicated in AssimilationKnowledgeExecution.
No deterministic Knowledge Engine, orchestration, query, reasoning, insight, Assimilation persistence, or filesystem persistence implementation behavior is redesigned.
No forbidden network, database, model, credential, process execution, deployment, publication, or autonomous authority is introduced.
requiredTests: KNOWLEDGE-003 successful production retrieval-execution-persistence integration test.
Authoritative production Assimilation retrieval delegation count and AssetId test.
Assimilation retrieval failure short-circuit test proving zero Knowledge execution and zero persistence.
Knowledge execution failure short-circuit test proving zero persistence.
Established TypeScript baseline verification with zero KNOWLEDGE-003 diagnostics.
safeguards: Do not commit until focused tests, complete Knowledge regression tests, established TypeScript baseline review, production build, architecture review, diff review, and exact staging review pass.
Do not push until the exact KNOWLEDGE-003 commit is verified and the explicit publication gate is reached.

Do not modify DeterministicKnowledgeEngine, KnowledgeGraph core types, KnowledgeGraphPersistence implementation, Assimilation production service, or orchestration handlers absent a failing authoritative test and a separately reviewed scope amendment.
Do not duplicate validateKnowledgeGraph or persistence path/serialization validation inside AssimilationKnowledgeExecution.
Do not silently derive the Knowledge persistence key from AssetId; preserve the explicit caller-supplied identity contract from KNOWLEDGE-002.
Do not persist before successful Knowledge execution.
Do not swallow retrieval, Knowledge execution, or persistence failures.
Do not introduce network, database, model, credential, process execution, deployment, publication, or autonomous authority.
commitMessage: KNOWLEDGE-003: Integrate production durable knowledge graph persistence
